definitions.gloss: preferred date; date one wishes (for delivery, an appointment, a reservation, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The date that a customer or applicant wishes to be selected — for a delivery, hospital visit, hotel reservation, interview, viewing, or service appointment. Standard label on Japanese order forms, booking sites, and request emails.

examples.japanese: {希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}して→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter your preferred delivery date.

examples.japanese: {希望日|きぼうび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{埋|う}まっている→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}して→提案する：06057_teiansuru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: If your preferred date is fully booked, they will suggest another day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{第三|だいさん}⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧し、⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write down your preferred interview dates up to a third choice, and send them by email.

notes:
{希望日|きぼうび} is the standard label on Japanese forms and order pages for "preferred date."

FORMS:
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ ("wish, hope, request") + {日|び} ("day, date") → {希望日|きぼうび}
- The ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ kanji voices to び in this compound (rendaku).

USAGE:
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred delivery date (online shopping)
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred reservation date (hotels, restaurants, clinics)
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred interview date (job applications)
- ⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred date for a tour / visit
- ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred date of use
- On Japanese e-commerce sites, the field for preferred delivery date is almost always labeled ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧{希望日|きぼうび} or お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧{希望日|きぼうび}.
- For polite written requests in business email, you will frequently see ご⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧ ("the date and time of your choice") as a more formal phrasing covering both date and time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ / ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to choose / specify a preferred date
- {希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to enter a preferred date (on a form)
- {希望日|きぼうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in a preferred date
- ⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧{希望日|きぼうび} / {第二|だいに}{希望日|きぼうび}: first / second choice of date
- {希望日|きぼうび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: the requested date doesn't work

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: preferred time
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧: preferred time slot (for delivery, etc.)
- {予約日|よやくび}: reserved date (the date that has been confirmed)
- {予定日|よていび}: scheduled date — the date that is on the calendar; can be the planned execution date or a target date
- {指定日|していび}: designated / specified date — slightly more formal; the date one has explicitly designated
